decidingOwner: Priority-recovery rebalancing owner (seed-side rebalancer / RebalanceCoordinator pre-execution handoff) owns the membership-settle gate and the per-partition CREATE_REPLICA dispatch cadence; raft learner-promotion (learner-promotion-progress) owns the per-replica catch-up proof floor.
missingTransitionOrObservation: A level-trigger/wakeup from 'replica reached voter-ready activation state' (e.g. adc2b37a 38176ms) to the recovery owner's next-partition CREATE_REPLICA dispatch, so the next partition's replica establishment is driven immediately rather than after a membership-settle poll/SWIM reconcile.
